en: A black-and-white image showing a rural European village set in a gently rolling landscape. The foreground contains an open field bordered by trees. In the midground, there are a cluster of houses with steeply pitched roofs, typical of Central European architecture. Several church spires and a larger institutional building (possibly a school or town hall) are visible, suggesting the central part of the village. The background consists of more open farmland and gentle hills.
